heroSubtitle: Which cookies we use, why, and how to manage your preferences.

sections.body: A cookie is a small text file placed on your device when you visit our site. In accordance with the GDPR and the recommendations of the Luxembourg CNPD, no non-essential cookie is set without your prior, explicit consent.
sections.title: What is a cookie?

sections.body: These cookies are essential for the site to function and cannot be disabled.
items: Management of your session and language preferences
Storage of your cookie consent choices (duration: 12 months)
sections.title: Strictly necessary cookies

sections.body: These cookies allow the site's traffic to be measured. They are only set with your prior consent.
items: Google Analytics 4 (Google LLC, United States): audience measurement — duration: 13 months
Google Tag Manager (Google LLC, United States): management of measurement tags
sections.title: Analytics cookies — consent required

sections.body: These cookies allow personalised ads to be shown. They are only set with your prior consent.
items: Meta Pixel (Meta Platforms Ireland Ltd): retargeting on Facebook and Instagram
LinkedIn Insight Tag (LinkedIn Ireland Unlimited Company): retargeting on LinkedIn
sections.title: Advertising cookies — consent required

sections.body:
You can change your cookie preferences at any time using the cookie management button available at the bottom of every page.

To learn more about your rights: www.cnpd.lu
sections.title: Manage your preferences

seoDescription: WellDoneDrill's cookie management policy: essential, analytics (GA4) and advertising (Meta, LinkedIn) cookies. Strict opt-in consent.
title: Cookie policy
